 Hon'Ble Vikram D. Chauhan, J. 
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.
2.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the first information report dated 20.5.2013 bearing Case Crime No.214 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Ghaziabad.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that in view of the order passed in application under Section 13B of Hindu Marriage Act dated 10.2.2018 recorded in Application U/S 482 No.21502 of 2018 (Harinath and 3 others Vs. State of U.P. and another), the present case be finally decided, as the same has been arises out of same proceedings.

sentences.text:
4. Learned AGA submits that the present case arises out of same proceedings in which compromise has already been recorded in Application U/S 482 No.21502 of 2018 (Harinath and 3 others Vs.
State of U.P. and another) and he would have no objection in case present criminal proceedings are put to an end.

sentences.text: 5. In view of compromise recorded in Application U/S 482 No.21502 of 2018 (Harinath and 3 others Vs. State of U.P. and another) the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is allowed and the criminal proceedings in the above mentioned case is quashed.
